description:
The Nalanda Award is a prestigious recognition established by the Government of India. 

It was launched on 27th September 2018. 

The award is named after the ancient Nalanda University. 

Nalanda University was one of the first residential universities in the world. 

It was located in Bihar and was a center for learning in ancient India. 

The Nalanda Award aims to honor individuals who have made significant contributions to the field of education. 

The primary objective of the Nalanda Award is to promote educational excellence. 

It seeks to encourage innovative practices in education. 

The award also aims to recognize the efforts of educators who have made a difference in society. 

The award is given annually. 

It is presented during the National Teachers' Day celebrations on 5th September. 

The award consists of a citation and a cash prize. 

The cash prize is worth INR 1,00,000. 

The award is open to teachers and educators across India. 

Eligibility for the Nalanda Award includes being a teacher in a recognized institution. 

Teachers must have a minimum of 10 years of teaching experience. 

They should demonstrate excellence in teaching methodologies. 

Innovative practices in education are also a criterion for eligibility. 

The application process for the Nalanda Award is straightforward. 

Interested candidates must submit their applications online. 

The application must include details of their teaching experience. 

Candidates should provide evidence of innovative practices they have implemented. 

Supporting documents such as certificates and testimonials are required. 

The application deadline is typically set for 31st July each year. 

After the submission deadline, applications are reviewed by a committee. 

The committee consists of experts in the field of education. 

They evaluate the applications based on predefined criteria. 

Winners are announced on Teachers' Day, 5th September. 

The award ceremony is organized by the Ministry of Education. 

The Ministry of Education is responsible for implementing the award. 

Contact details for the Ministry of Education can be found on their official website. 

The award aims to inspire teachers to adopt innovative teaching practices. 

It also encourages them to contribute to the overall development of students. 

The Nalanda Award is part of a broader initiative to enhance the quality of education in India. 

It aligns with the National Education Policy 2020. 

The policy emphasizes the importance of quality education and teacher training. 

The Nalanda Award serves as a motivation for educators to excel in their profession. 

It highlights the importance of recognizing the contributions of teachers. 

The award also aims to create role models for aspiring educators. 

The Nalanda Award is not just a recognition but a celebration of educational achievements. 

It reflects the government's commitment to improving education standards in India. 

The award has gained recognition and respect within the educational community. 

It encourages a culture of appreciation for teaching as a noble profession. 

The Nalanda Award also promotes the sharing of best practices among educators. 

This sharing can lead to improved educational outcomes across the country. 

The award is a step towards fostering a more knowledgeable society. 

It acknowledges the pivotal role of teachers in shaping future generations. 

The Nalanda Award has the potential to impact the educational landscape positively. 

It encourages educators to strive for excellence in their teaching methods. 

The award also emphasizes the importance of lifelong learning for teachers. 

The Nalanda Award is a significant initiative in the realm of educational welfare. 

It serves as a reminder of the historical significance of Nalanda University. 

The legacy of Nalanda University continues to inspire educational reforms in India. 

The award is a testament to the enduring value of education in society. 

The Nalanda Award is a beacon of hope for educators across India. 

It encourages them to innovate and inspire their students. 

The recognition provided by the award can enhance the reputation of educational institutions. 

It can also lead to increased funding and support for innovative educational programs. 

The Nalanda Award is an essential part of India's commitment to quality education. 

It aims to create a more educated and skilled workforce for the future. 

The award is a celebration of the transformative power of education. 

Through the Nalanda Award, the government seeks to honor the unsung heroes of education. 

Teachers play a crucial role in the development of society. 

The Nalanda Award is a way to acknowledge their hard work and dedication. 

It serves as an inspiration for future generations of educators. 

The award is a significant milestone in the journey towards educational excellence in India. 

It reflects the government's recognition of the importance of teachers in nation-building. 

The Nalanda Award is a proud moment for the education sector in India. 

It is a reminder that quality education is the foundation of a prosperous society. 

The award encourages educators to continue their pursuit of excellence. 

It fosters a spirit of collaboration and innovation in the educational community. 

The Nalanda Award is a symbol of hope for a brighter future through education.
